info.title: UK Accounting Platform API
info.description:
Practice-first accounting, tax and compliance platform. **V0 foundation:** identity, tenancy, RBAC, documents, jobs, audit, outbox events, workflows, tasks, notifications, integration and AI abstractions.

All tenant data lives under `/organisations/{organisationId}` and is protected by authentication, RBAC, company scope and PostgreSQL row-level security. Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
info.x-api-versioning: URI versioning (/api/v1). Additive changes only within a version; breaking changes ship as /api/v2.

cookie.name: uk_session
cookie.description: httpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie set by `POST /auth/login`. Unsafe methods must send an allowed `Origin`.

403.description: Authenticated but not permitted (RBAC, segregation of duties, CSRF origin)

404.description: Not found — also returned for resources in other organisations (existence is never revealed)
